notes: §1985:VII.4.3.3 SR2: 'The EXTEND phrase must not be specified for a multiple file reel.'; a file is on one when the MULTIPLE FILE TAPE clause names it (§1985:VII.2.11.3 GR1). FileControlBinder.ScreenMultipleFileClause records each named file's reel on FileModel.MultipleFileReels, and StatementValidation.CheckOpenModeForFile, called per file-name of every OPEN group by SequentialIoBinder, refuses EXTEND on such a file with COBOL6814 at every edition (the clause itself is COBOL0902 from 2002, so 85 is the edition it reaches). Probes at --std 85: the witness (EXTEND of the first file) and EXTEND of the second file, EXTEND in a multi-group OPEN (OUTPUT F3 EXTEND F1), a POSITION-phrase clause, a one-file clause and a relative file on the reel (COBOL6814 plus GR20 d's COBOL6816) are all refused; OUTPUT/INPUT of a reel file and EXTEND of an OPTIONAL file off the reel run (ABC written and read back). Classes b, c (2023: COBOL0902 on the clause) and e (sequential and relative organizations, a failed OPEN EXTEND of a missing non-optional file gives status 35); a, d, f do not reach an OPEN syntax rule.

next.reason: 1985: "The EXTEND phrase must not be specified for a multiple file reel."; 2023: "The EXTEND phrase shall be specified only if the access mode ... is sequential and the LINAGE clause is not specified". The 2023 EXTEND restrictions (SR-14.9.27.3-2) cover only access mode and LINAGE. No candidate mentions multiple file reels, so the 1985 prohibition is no longer stated.
